snippet.title: Cucina Stellata | Out Now For Free | CRTime
snippet.description:
Cucina Stellata is a short psychological horror that explores how far one is willing to descend while pursuing fleeting appetites. Prepare authentic rustic dishes in tactile cooking sequences as a bottomless hunger erases the lines between nourishment and madness.

This is a totally free game released over CRTime. Why not check it out?

Supporter pack also available.

Out Now for Free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3976340/Cucina_Stellata/

Coming soon to XBOX on PC.
